description: Reference stories that define the StoryTime quality bar. Each entry records the request that produced the story, so the judge (agents/JUDGE_AGENT.md §5) can score it with its real inputs. Bibles are reconstructed from the stories and represent the series state BEFORE each story was written.

children.name: Milo

request.topic_input: how Lego was invented and the first kids who used it
the history of computer gaming leading all the way to when Roblox was created

recurring.name: The magic red LEGO brick
recurring.rule: glows and clicks to start an adventure; returns them home at the end

last_story.title: Milo, Juno and the Brick That Clicked
last_story.ending: Back home, the final brick on their giant tower just went CLICK and held.

children.name: Theo
children.notes: plays on a youth soccer team; practices penalties

recurring.name: Bit
recurring.rule: green 8-bit pixel guide; squeaky, jokes about being 8-bit; eyes go watery at the end

recurring.name: Golden coins
recurring.rule: one per saved level; fuse into a trophy at the end

last_story.title: Theo and the Lost Levels

expected_bible_additions: penalty kick as Theo's signature move

notes: Stories 1 and 3 use British spelling; stories 2 and 4 use American spelling. The app should default to American spelling; do not penalize the references for this.
The soccer story deliberately stops at the 2022 World Cup and omits the 2026 tournament; this is a content choice, not a factual gap.
All four should score >= 4.5 overall on the judge rubric. If they do not, fix the judge prompt, not the stories.
